# Monod

## Takeaway

Monod fits stochastic transcriptional dynamics using nascent and mature RNA measurements. It provides a biophysical route to compare transcriptional states and integrate observations when the required matched inputs exist.

## Input and output

- Input: matched nascent and mature count matrices plus the model configuration.
- Output: kinetic parameters, model comparison summaries and uncertainty.
- Record: labeling protocol, count construction, priors, optimizer and convergence diagnostics.

## Official material

- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02832-x
- Code: https://github.com/pachterlab/monod
- Examples: https://github.com/pachterlab/monod_examples
- Turnkey entry: python/05_monod_template.py.

## Limitation

Monod is not a drop-in replacement for standard differential expression or RNA velocity. The input measurement design must support the biological model.
